tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Light grey paper in the light theme, near-black in the dark theme.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Inset or raised panels on surface-100 (forms, table stripes).

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Image areas and dark sections in BOTH themes. Any element on this fill carries data-surface="dark" so the pixel layer and cursor turn bright over it.

tokens.name: surface-dark-raised
tokens.usage: Panels on surface-dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, icons, hairline squares and solid buttons on surface-100 and surface-200 (17:1 light, 17:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and mono labels on surface-100 and surface-200 (6.1:1 light, 7.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-dark and surface-dark-raised (19:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Captions on surface-dark (8:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and section rules on surface-100 (ink at 18%). Decorative: never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: hairline-on-dark
tokens.usage: 1px dividers on surface-dark (white at 18%).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Electric blue from the blue poster. Links, focus ring, selected state on surface-100 (7.0:1 light, 7.1:1 dark). Text and rings only; never a large gradient.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (7.7:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface. 7:1 on surface-100 in both themes. On surface-dark use ink-on-dark instead.

tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Light button fill on surface-dark and images (nothing.tech style).

tokens.name: ink-fixed
tokens.usage: Text on surface-white in both themes (19:1).

tokens.name: header-glass
tokens.usage: Floating header bar fill (80%), always with a 45px backdrop blur. ink reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: menu-glass
tokens.usage: Menu panel fill (90%) with a 45px backdrop blur; ink entries on it (15:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims and blurs the page behind the open menu.

tokens.name: pixel-color
tokens.usage: Dot colour of the static pixel grid. Drawn with a difference blend at pixel-opacity, so dots read grey-dark on surface-100 and grey-light on surface-dark.

tokens.name: cursor-square
tokens.usage: The single fill of every cursor square (white at 25%) with a 6px backdrop blur. No border.

tokens.name: duotone
tokens.usage: Screen-blend tint for duotone project images: black areas turn electric blue, white stays white. Fades out when the image resolves.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Secondary dark tone from the dark poster. Large fills only.

tokens.name: pale-grey-green
tokens.usage: Secondary light tone from the dark poster. Large fills only; ink on it is 12:1.

styles.name: body-18
styles.sample: A short intro in sentence case.

styles.name: mono-14
styles.usage: Buttons and text links (uppercase), contact values.

styles.name: mono-12
styles.usage: Index numbers, labels, metadata. Set uppercase for labels.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Half unit: pixel dot size, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Tight gaps, segment gaps in skill bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button padding, label gaps, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gutter, header side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Block spacing inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header height; space between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty space beside an off-grid project image.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Pixels, cursor squares, skill segments, section markers: anything that is a pixel stays square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Floating header bar, menu panel, project image frames.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Desktop grid columns.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Column gap on the 12-column grid.

tokens.name: header-max
tokens.usage: Width of the floating header bar and the menu panel.

tokens.name: header-bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the floating header bar.

tokens.name: header-inset
tokens.usage: Gap between the viewport edge and the header bar or menu panel.

tokens.name: hairline-width
tokens.usage: Dividers and outline borders.

tokens.name: pixel-columns
tokens.usage: The dot grid places one dot per column line: 13 dots across the viewport width (inside pixel-inset).

tokens.name: pixel-columns-mobile
tokens.usage: Dot-grid columns below 768px.

tokens.name: pixel-inset
tokens.usage: Inset of the dot grid from the viewport edges (16px on mobile).

tokens.name: pixel-dot
tokens.usage: Side of one square dot.

duration.note: Timings for the effects. Values are milliseconds.

tokens.name: scramble-tick
tokens.usage: Unresolved characters re-randomise this often.

tokens.name: form-headline
tokens.usage: Time for a headline or label to resolve (600 to 900).

tokens.name: form-paragraph
tokens.usage: Time for a paragraph line to resolve (900 to 1400).

tokens.name: form-line-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between lines of one text block.

tokens.name: menu-entry-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between menu entries forming.

tokens.name: cursor-wave
tokens.usage: Outward wave on click, ease-out.

tokens.name: reveal-step
tokens.usage: Time per pixel-size step when a project image resolves.

tokens.name: scramble-start
tokens.usage: Opacity of unresolved scramble characters.

tokens.name: pixel-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the whole dot-grid layer.

zIndex.note: Layer order: content, menu scrim, menu panel, pixel grid, header, cursor.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-menu-scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed page behind the open menu.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menu panel, below the dot grid so dots stay visible in the menu.

tokens.name: z-pixels
tokens.usage: Static dot-grid layer.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Floating header bar; its burger becomes the menu's close button.

tokens.name: z-cursor
tokens.usage: Custom cursor, always on top.
